title: Dragit pengar utan tillåtelse
body:
Hej,

Jag kontaktar er angående en debitering på 699,00 kr för Alarmy Pro (upphör 24 april 2027).

Jag vill tydligt framföra att jag inte medvetet har valt att prenumerera på denna tjänst. Jag valde enbart den kostnadsfria testperioden och har inte godkänt någon övergång till en betald prenumeration.

Trots detta har pengar dragits från mitt konto, vilket jag anser vara felaktigt. Dessutom använder jag inte appen och har inte haft någon nytta av tjänsten efter testperioden.

Med hänvisning till ovanstående ber jag om en full återbetalning av det debiterade beloppet samt att prenumerationen avslutas omedelbart.

Jag ser fram emot ert svar och en snabb lösning på detta ärende.

Vänliga hälsningar,
Maryam

title: Make it more customizable!
body:
Let me first say I can’t live without this app. At least I’d have a hard time keeping a job without it. That said, it’s gone from great to not so great, and I ask you to step up your game because I’ll jump ship as soon as I find a decent replacement.

What’s with that bloody horoscope? Why are you trying to force some quasi-religious crap on me? Don’t implement such a BS feature without the option to hide it from the summary! F that!

Another thing is the news section. Until quite recently, it was a good way for me to come to my senses while waiting for the Wake Up Check. It got the brain going. Nowadays I wake up just from pure frustration every day because 9/10 articles are pay-walled, making the whole thing utterly useless!

I don’t know what service you’re using for news, but they need to let users decide which outlets to source, or you need to look for another provider! The whole news section is in desperate need of some user customizability. The whole app is! Give us more options if you want us to keep paying for a friggin’ subscription!

One feature that would help me a lot would be the option to set individual pictures for each alarm. Also a language setting for the text-to-speech would make it more useful.

title: Good alarm, poor monetization strategy
body:
I love the photo alarm feature because it helps be get out of bed in the morning. I would like to support the creators and get rid of the ads but making this a subscription based service and asking $50 (~450SEK) per year is too steep. I can’t get behind that. 

Recently I also received a unsolicited notification that the app had a birthday and there was a contest being run. This is spam-like behavior. You need to have notifications enabled for the app in order to have it save you if you accidentally kill the app in the background (great feature) so you will need to have notifications on. And since there is no controls for selecting relevant notifications you cannot escape notifications like these. 

5 star functionality in a 3 star package (minus for being too expensive and sending irrelevant notifications). If the app’s unique functionality is key to your survival then go for it. I will be looking for a different app with a more reasonable pricing model.

title: Battery usage
body:
Background activity... That word pretty much sums it up. 

I’ve loved this app up until just now, always worked great, it has woken me up countless times. BUT for some reason it has started using more and more battery... Tonight this one single handedly killed my iPhone’s battery during my sleep - which led to the obvious situation of no alarm... According to the ”battery-usage” report in the phone, this app just accelerated, through 11 pm-12 am it used ”only” 59%, going further through 12 am-1 am 92%, and last but not least through 1 am-2 am 100%. 

Yesterday I would’ve recommended this app, today - not so much. It has to go.

body: Försover mig fortfarande. Men för att jag ändå är dum nog att krypa tillbaka till sängen efteråt. Sedan hittar man alltid kryphål 🙈 Men den ökar chanserna genom att få upp en ur sängen iaf. Lite stressigt med mattetalen då de är så kort tid, skulle behövt nån minut till på sig så att  man kan välja svårare tal och hinner vakna till ordentligt! 😅 Skulle gärna även älska att se att man kunde kombinera alla 3 kraven istället för att bara välja 1. Så att både kroppen och hjärnan tvingas vakna till liv innan man får bort alarmet! 😊👍👍
